prompt: Write 10 distinct memories an assistant at Larkmere Mutual keeps about individual members, from what each member said about: a neighbour's house flooded last winter (theme: Flood risk). One or two sentences each, in the third person ("The member…", "They…"), each about a different member. No names. Be concrete and varied: family, work, ages, towns in England and Wales, amounts in pounds, months. This batch leans towards families with young children. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 12)
